bullets.text: A German boat dealer is suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, with nearly a third of migrant crossings in early 2026 allegedly involving boats or engines from his firm, according to a BBC investigation. Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France on charges including smuggling and involuntary manslaughter.
A diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsized near Ibiza, resulting in one fatality. Spanish sea rescue services are currently assessing the potential environmental damage from the incident.
A cheaper, twice-yearly HIV prevention injection, Lenacapavir, has arrived in Africa, offering hope to millions. This new jab is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.
Over 80 Australians were injured in 2025 due to unsafe products purchased through online marketplaces, prompting consumer watchdog concerns about the true scale of the problem.
A remote Australian community is becoming a focal point for the space industry, with a new rocket company, RangeOz, developing a launch site near the existing Koonibba Test Range.

Concerns have been raised about the use of smart glasses by a One Nation volunteer outside an early polling booth in Victoria's west, leading to incidents reported to the state's electoral commission.
The Federal Reserve is expected to increase interest rates, prioritizing inflation control despite recent stock market volatility and fears of an economic downturn.
Ghana has bought back $1.1 billion in domestic bonds ahead of schedule to reassure investors, as its economy recovers from a debt restructuring.
Global stock markets are rising, driven by a rebound in technology shares, while copper prices also recovered from an 11-month low.
